records.text: The wedding photo was visible behind Mikey McCoy when he appeared from Charlie Kirk's home studio on September 22.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So hard and so quickly that another sleuth found him on September 22nd seated in Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s chair at home. ... Mikey (Mikey McCoy) the amazing shared a similar message with Martha McCollum on Fox News. And you can see just at the end of that, this little screenshot that Mikey (Mikey McCoy), you see the photo in the background.

verification.notes: Fox hosts the September 22 Mikey McCoy interview, but the available page metadata/transcript does not establish the claimed background detail and no independently preserved frame was located that reliably confirms the wedding photo.
